title: Bounds on a restricted Fourier observation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates in $ br^n$, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$. For every Boolean target function, every assignment of signs to the coordinates outside $J$, and every two assignments of signs to the coordinates in $J$, the restricted Fourier weight observation lies in $[-1,1]$.
